en:
Nyum-nyum... This is an official announcement
from the Ultimate Academy.

It's 8 a.m., bitches! Time to wake up and
face the blood-drenched day!
I wonder who's dead this morning?

Stooop... If I suddenly see a dead body, I'll
puke again!

Phew, it was all some terrible dream...
Ha, wouldn't that be nice?

<CLT=cltMIND>Wait, I don't have time to joke around.
I said I'd meet the others in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone must be waiting... I need to
get to the dining hall ASAP.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
